purpose: Teach: キュウリ/とうもろこし/にっこり/ガソリンスタンド/ホームセンター/クラスメート/うっすら/気さく

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、夏メニューの、本気で、絶対、キュウリ、絶対、サンドイッチ、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、好きよ
lines.en: Aoi, that summer cucumber sandwich is absolutely perfect — I'm serious, it's my favorite.
lines.style: Warm, immediate. Speaks with genuine affection and certainty. Leans forward slightly on 'Aoi.' Light, unhurried pace. The tone of someone sharing something true about someone she likes.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。地元の、本気で、絶対、とうもろこし、絶対、葵、絶対、仕入れたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, and I sourced the corn local this time. Really fresh.
lines.style: Bright, genuine pride underneath. Relaxed openness—no performance. A small smile in the voice. The confidence of someone sharing something she's done well.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様、絶対、にっこり、絶対、迎えてあげてるよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: You know, you greet every customer with that smile. I really admire that about you.
lines.style: Sincere observation. Tender but not sugary. Speaks slowly enough to land each word. Looks at Aoi directly. The tone of someone saying something they've noticed and held onto.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、駅前の、絶対、ガソリンスタンド、絶対、新しくなったって、知ってる?葵で
lines.en: Speaking of which—did you notice the gas station near the station just got renovated?
lines.style: Conversational shift, natural curiosity. Lighter tone. Testing whether Aoi notices things too. A gentle, companionable prompt to share.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の備品、本気で、絶対、ホームセンター、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、見に行こうかな
lines.en: I was thinking I might take you to the home center soon—need some new things for the shop anyway.
lines.style: Soft suggestion, not urgent. Speaks as if thinking aloud. The pace of someone who's comfortable with pauses. Underneath: hope that Aoi will want to go.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昔のクラスメート、本気で、絶対、葵のお店、絶対、来てくれたわよ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、嬉しい
lines.en: You know, an old classmate came by the shop the other day. I was so happy to see them.
lines.style: Animated, warm recollection. Voice lifts on the memory. Open and pleased. Speaks like someone who still treasures those connections and is delighted to talk about them.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、朝、絶対、うっすら、絶対、明るくなる時間、絶対、素敵よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The way the morning light comes through your shop, just as it's getting bright—it's so lovely.
lines.style: Soft, reflective. Quieter than before. The voice of someone noticing small, tender things. Speaks slowly, almost thinking aloud. Genuine appreciation without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお客様の中に、本気で、絶対、気さくな、絶対、ご常連、絶対、いらっしゃるのよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You have such warm regulars. They're nice people—comfortable people.
lines.style: Warm, observant. Speaks as someone who's watched and noticed the quality of Aoi's small world. Gentle affection for both Aoi and the people around her. At ease.
